pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with highly serrated, star-like edge gradients. Geometric forms exhibit variable spatial area with larger dark regions on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored topological network with high-frequency junction nodes where three or more pathways meet. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively consistent across the lateral torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the cervical dorsal line, characterized by short, stiff hair structures against a neutral background.
